title.en: China's Supreme People's Court issues guidance for AI-related disputes
title.zhHans: 中国最高人民法院发布涉人工智能纠纷审理意见

searchSummary.en: China's Supreme People's Court issued a 24-article set of Opinions directing lower courts on AI-related disputes, covering personality rights, data, intellectual property, products, evidence, and procedural issues.
searchSummary.zhHans: 中国最高人民法院发布包含 24 条的《意见》，指导下级法院审理涉人工智能纠纷，涉及人格权、数据、知识产权、产品、证据与程序问题。

summary.en: On September 7, China's Supreme People's Court issued the Opinions on Lawfully Hearing Cases Involving Artificial Intelligence Disputes. The 24-article document directs courts applying existing Chinese law to disputes involving generative AI, training data, AI products, autonomous and assisted driving, intellectual property, evidence, and AI-assisted litigation. It is judicial guidance under existing statutes, not a dedicated national AI law. The Opinions address several practical liabilities while leaving some contested questions, including copyrightability of AI-generated works, unresolved.
summary.zhHans: 9 月 7 日，中国最高人民法院发布《关于依法审理涉人工智能纠纷案件的意见》。这份包含 24 条的文件指导法院依据现有中国法律审理涉及生成式 AI、训练数据、AI 产品、自动驾驶与辅助驾驶、知识产权、证据和 AI 辅助诉讼的争议。它是基于现有法律的司法指导，而非专门的国家 AI 法。该《意见》处理了若干实际责任问题，同时将包括 AI 生成内容可版权性在内的一些争议问题留待解决。

narrative.en: The Opinions say courts should apply existing civil, cybersecurity, data, copyright, consumer-protection, personal-information, and procedural law while balancing innovation and safety. They include guidance on unauthorized AI face or voice imitation, data-use disputes, developer and provider liability, evidentiary review, and verification of AI-generated litigation material. Independent legal analysis notes that the document does not establish a complete AI statute or settle every contested training and copyright question. Its significance is therefore a national judicial framework for applying existing rules, not proof that a single, comprehensive AI liability regime has been enacted.
narrative.zhHans: 《意见》要求法院适用现有民事、网络安全、数据、著作权、消费者保护、个人信息与程序法律，并在创新与安全之间平衡。内容包括对未经许可的 AI 换脸和拟声、数据使用争议、开发者与服务提供者责任、证据审查，以及 AI 生成诉讼材料核验的指导。独立法律分析指出，该文件并未建立完整的 AI 专门法，也没有解决所有训练和版权争议。因此，它的重要性在于为适用现有规则提供全国性司法框架，而不是证明一套统一、全面的 AI 责任制度已经出台。

description.en: Creates a national judicial reference point for resolving AI-related disputes under existing Chinese law across rights, product, data, and procedure questions.
description.zhHans: 为依据现有中国法律处理涉及权利、产品、数据与程序问题的 AI 纠纷建立全国性司法参照。

text.en: China's Supreme People's Court issued 24 articles of AI-dispute adjudication guidance on September 7, 2026.
text.zhHans: 中国最高人民法院于 2026 年 9 月 7 日发布了包含 24 条的涉 AI 纠纷审理指导意见。

text.en: The Opinions set out how courts should apply existing law to topics including AI-related personality rights, products, training-data use, intellectual property, evidence, and AI-assisted litigation.
text.zhHans: 《意见》说明了法院应如何将现有法律适用于 AI 相关的人格权、产品、训练数据使用、知识产权、证据及 AI 辅助诉讼等议题。

text.en: The document is guidance under existing law, not a dedicated AI statute, and it leaves unsettled questions such as copyrightability of AI-generated works.
text.zhHans: 该文件是现有法律下的指导意见，而非专门 AI 法；它仍将诸如 AI 生成内容可版权性等问题留待解决。

editorial.reviewNotes: L2. National judicial guidance under existing law; does not overstate the document as a new dedicated AI statute or final answer to all AI copyright questions.
